pages.title: Before it disappears
pages.label: Before It Disappears
pages.subtitle: Twelve photographs from villages in the Lebanese hills. Ordinary things, made while they were still there.

blocks.title: The road in
blocks.alt: A road curving through pine hills under a pale sky, white flowers along its edge

blocks.title: Bougainvillea
blocks.alt: Pink bougainvillea spilling over the roof of a small concrete building

blocks.title: He looked back
blocks.alt: Close portrait of an elderly man with white hair, smiling quietly

blocks.title: The game
blocks.alt: An old man holding a pale fruit beside a cracked concrete wall, a ball on the ground

blocks.title: The kitchen
blocks.alt: An old man in a dark coat standing at a stove in a small yellow kitchen

blocks.title: Afternoon, the street
blocks.alt: Three children racing along a street, one on a bicycle

blocks.text: Most of what these photographs show is not rare. It is simply about to be gone.
blocks.title: From the series
The pine
blocks.alt: A tall pine tree leaning over a quiet village road with a lone figure walking
blocks.note: A pine above the last turn of the village road.

blocks.title: Under the leaves
blocks.alt: A man standing beneath a dense green tree, only his legs visible

blocks.title: Through the gate
blocks.alt: A white cat seen through iron bars in a stone courtyard

blocks.title: Parked, waiting
blocks.alt: A grey sedan under a dust cover in a stone garage

blocks.title: Wall, late light
blocks.alt: Thorn-branch shadows on a sunlit plaster wall

blocks.title: The valley
blocks.alt: Two men talking at a railing above an olive valley, an old tree trunk in the foreground

blocks.text: Habib Saleh photographs and makes films. This series was made over two years, on visits to villages in Lebanon, in the light of ordinary afternoons.
The photographs are available as prints and as a short film.
